dedupe_keys.name: oasis piwind uk windstorm demonstration model

description: Oasis PiWind is a deliberately small UK windstorm catastrophe model published by Oasis Loss Modelling Framework contributors. It supplies a complete model configuration that can be run through the Oasis Model Development Kit, producing example event losses and financial outputs. Users provide exposure assets, vulnerability and hazard assumptions, and the bundled JSON configuration; outputs are loss tables for the selected synthetic storms. Geographic coverage is a toy United Kingdom domain, not a calibrated national risk product. BSD-2-Clause source and command-line run instructions are public. A limitation is central to its identity: the README calls it a toy model, so its damage functions and outputs must not be treated as insurance or infrastructure design estimates. It is valuable as a reproducible benchmark for testing wind-risk pipelines and loss calculations. The catalogue's model-nist-fds-smokeview addresses a different hazard. No exposure archive, model package or sample loss file was downloaded.
